# Currency Rates

Part of the **Support** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List currency rates

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates`

Retrieve a paginated list of currency rates for a specific currency with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `currency_id` | integer | Yes | The currency ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, creator | `currency` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of company IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by rate date (YYYY-MM-DD) |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates?include=currency&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates?include=currency&sort=name&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates?include=currency&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

## Create currency rate

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates`

Create a new currency exchange rate for a specific currency

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `currency_id` | integer | Yes | The currency ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Rate effective date (YYYY-MM-DD format). Must be a valid date. |
| `rate` | number | Yes | Exchange rate (minimum 0). Must be at least 0. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID (optional, null for global rates). Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "2024-01-15",
  "rate": 1.25,
  "company_id": 1
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "2024-01-15",
  "rate": 1.25,
  "company_id": 1
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => '2024-01-15',
    'rate' => 1.25,
    'company_id' => 1,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/currencies/{currency_id}/rates"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "2024-01-15",
    "rate": 1.25,
    "company_id": 1,
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="201" />

```json

    "name": "1996-01-25T00:00:00.000000Z",
```
